text:
emma: Quick follow-up for the Token-Service marathon outage. Consolidating actions and owners so we can close the PM. Please confirm or request a handoff within 36h.

Actions (short):
1) Add circuit-breaker + exp backoff to token fetcher (JIRA-7210)
2) Canary for token-service config rollouts (JIRA-7211)
3) Increase observability for token cache evictions (JIRA-7212)
4) Postmortem recurrence review + board automation (internal)
5) Runbook tabletop and verification test (JIRA-7213)

emma: My initial owner suggestions: 7210 -> raj, 7211 -> tom, 7212 -> celia, 7213 -> emma. Please ack or swap.

raj: I'll take 7210. Plan: implement breaker + metrics, add unit + integration tests. Target: PR in 4 business days. Will add the quick mitigation flag if we see regressions.

celia: I'll own 7212. Will add per-shard eviction metrics, histogram of TTLs, and attach sample traces. Tentative ETA: 3 business days. Noted repeated evictions at ~04:20 UTC in prod.

tom: I'll pick up 7211 but want eng-deploy consult. Proposed RACI: Tom (R), eng-deploy (C), Emma (A), Raj (I). I'll open a subtask for the canary gating and add testcases for rollback.

ops-bot: Created JIRA-7211.1 for canary harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-7211.1

pm-bot: Auto-tagged PM as "recurrence-candidate" (occurrences=3) and added a weekly review card: https://board.redwood.local/postmortems/recurrence

emma: Thanks. Two process asks: a) add "remediation-verification" comment with deployment SHA + smoke-run ID before PM close, b) split cross-team remediations into subtasks so each team has a clear RACI.

raj: Agree on subtasks. I'll add a small feature-flagged throttle as a temporary mitigation too. Will assign integration testing to @tom.

celia: For 7212 I'll attach sample heap snapshots and an example kdump. If I can't reproduce in staging, I'll schedule a short sync with infra.

tom: Opening JIRA-7211.1 and assigning eng-deploy. Will include rollback hooks and a healthcheck evaluator that fails if p99 latency crosses threshold during canary.

emma: I'll draft the tabletop script for 7213 and post a PR to ops-runbooks. Plan: include a simulated token-service failure in the smoke suite and require verification steps in the PR template.

raj: Quick note: for 7210 the breaker should be per-tenant (not global) to avoid cascading across customers. Adding that to the ticket.

celia: +1 to per-tenant. Also propose an alert that triggers if eviction rate doubles baseline for >10m. Adding alert suggestion to 7212.

emma: Closing owner assignment in 36h unless someone asks to swap. When you accept here, update the JIRA with RACI and due-date. Final ask: include the verification comment format: "remediation-verification: SHA=<sha> smoke=<id> traces=<link>" so PM can close. :white_check_mark:

tom: Ack. Opening subtask now.

raj: Ack. Will update JIRA with RACI and ETA.

celia: Acked. Will post findings in the ticket and ping for any cross-team tests.
